public_rationale: Hardware replacements and better successor performance are documented. Resale evidence shows both depreciation and rebounds. Those findings support parts of the claim but do not settle its combined lifecycle prediction. A literal claim that resale prices never increase is challenged by the index; treating that as decisive would make the outcome depend on a stricter reading than the car analogy necessarily implies.
limitations: The successor benchmark is reported by NVIDIA and combines hardware with software improvements.
The resale provider is a market participant, and the index can be revised.
Five years is illustrative, not a deadline.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: AI GPUs can and will break after extended usage, whether after five years or later, will inevitably be superseded by something better, and their resale value will only go down, depreciating like a new car.
conditions: whether that period is five years or later

statement.excerpt: These are cards that can — and will — break after a period of extended usage, whether that period is five years or later, and they’ll inevitably be superseded by something better and more powerful, meaning that the resale value of that GPU will only go down, with a price depreciation that’s akin to a new car.

our_interpretation: Assess data-center AI GPUs as a class, using comparable models and hardware cohorts.
Five years or later is not a five-year deadline or a promise that every unit fails at the same age.
The ordinary lifecycle reading predicts eventual hardware retirement, better successors and substantial depreciation from new purchase to used resale.
The car analogy does not specify a depreciation percentage. Temporary market rebounds alone do not refute lifecycle depreciation, although they challenge a literal reading of only go down.
criteria.support_condition: Longitudinal operating records, successor benchmarks and comparable completed resale transactions jointly establish finite service lives, superior successors and substantial lifecycle value loss for representative AI GPU cohorts.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable lifecycle evidence materially defeats the predicted depreciation pattern or another essential component. Under a strictly monotonic reading, verified resale-price increases would contradict the price clause.
